methodology: Production fixtures prepared with grit-bench daily. One warmup, then ten interleaved runs each of system Git, origin/main, reviewed grit and corrected grit, reversing tool order every other run. Wall time measured with Python perf_counter around /usr/bin/time -v; median wall time and maximum peak RSS reported. No builds or tests ran during measurement. All count outputs checked against system Git before timing. Reviewed grit is the original count optimization before preserving graph-only exclusions. The previous VM baseline remains in filtered-revision-count.json.

profile.memory_profile_method: Five interleaved executions per binary of revs --count --author=. HEAD on the graph-free production fixture; sample /proc/<pid>/smaps_rollup every 2 ms. Separate profiling session, not part of timing measurements.
